pages.text: $(bold)Self-Enclosed Sphere$(): touch and transform - life reshaped by hand.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x60 curse power per second. Every target inside except the caster $(red)undergoes one transfiguration$(): mobs are instantly replaced by a $(bold)guardian shikigami$() of the chosen form (tamed, permanent); players are forcibly morphed in person (60-second time limit, tools disabled throughout).

$(bold)Form$(): if the caster has learned Wu Wei and set a transformation target on the form screen (P key), every target inside takes on $(bold)that form$(); otherwise they default to $(bold)a random zombie or skeleton$().$(br2)$(bold)Resisting$(): as with Taizang Field - the $(bold)universal resistance period applies$() (a target entering for the first time resists briefly), and the $(bold)three New Shadow Style techniques work$() (immune to the transfiguration while they have enough curse power); the caster's own shikigami, cursed spirits, and guardians are never transfigured. Only Execution cannot be resisted.
